divergence_justification: Judge accepted the contested paired residual: full data produced 93,378 candidate and oracle rows, with 92,721 identical and 657 line_site conflicts only. Canonical invasive_line.sql:10,90-127 preserves procedureevents.location, but upstream mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_procedure_icu.sql:12 applies TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(pe.location, '\s+', ' ', 'g')) and lines 62-69 serialize only the normalized value as Procedure.bodySite.coding.code. The discarded whitespace is unrecoverable by any FHIR query because no raw copy is serialized and the normalization is many-to-one. This is ancillary formatting loss that changes no row inclusion, grain, multiplicity, grouping, timing, or clinical meaning.

The attempt adds the paired key column beside each MIMIC identifier column (subject_id->patient_key, hadm_id->encounter_key, stay_id->icu_encounter_key, specimen_id->specimen_key). Additive and shape-only: both comparison paths project manifest columns explicitly, so no compared value can change. The MIMIC integer columns are retained as the oracle join keys.
